nodes.description: Hai đường thẳng đồng phẳng và có tất cả các điểm chung, hoặc trong không gian khi hai vectơ chỉ phương cùng phương và chúng có chung một điểm.

assignments.rationale: This occurrence describes the concept of two coincident lines in a plane, defined by sharing all points. It is a foundational geometric concept.

This occurrence describes a theorem providing a vector condition for two lines in space to be coincident. It is a specific, reusable mathematical result about the same underlying concept of coincident lines, albeit in a different context (space vs. plane). Grade difference and context shift (plane to space) do not warrant a split as the core mathematical knowledge (coincident lines) is the same. The theorem is a property of the concept.
